{{nihongo|'''Mushika Shrine'''|虫鹿神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Owari Province]].

=== Overview ===
Its founding period is unknown. It was also called Mushika Tenjin and Sanmyōjin Shrine.

Originally it stood in Iruka village, Niwa District, Owari Province. In the early {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}}, for new field development under the {{ill|Owari Domain|de|Owari (Han)|fa|قلمرو اوواری|fr|Domaine d'Owari|ja|尾張藩|ko|오와리번|ru|Овари (княжество)|th|แคว้นศักดินาโอวาริ|zh|尾張藩|qid=Q1062072}}, an irrigation reservoir ({{ill|Lake Iruka|de|Irukaike|fr|Lac Iruka|hu|Iruka-tó|ja|入鹿池|ko|이루카이케|pl|Zbiornik Iruka|pt|Lago Iruka|ru|Ирука|sr|Језеро Ирука|zh|入鹿池|qid=Q927013}}) was built, and Iruka village was submerged. The people of Iruka village relocated to surrounding areas, and Mushika Shrine was also relocated.

The shrine was decided to move to Maehara Shinden, where the largest number of Iruka villagers relocated, and in {{ill|1635|Q6879|qid=Q6879}} (Kan'ei 12) it was transferred to the current site.

The current shrine building is said to date from that relocation.
